// Classifier fixture, node:test: TITLE-CONTRADICTION, one positive per reason, and the negative of
// each. Read as text by tests/classify.test.ts.
import { test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

test("returns null when no bundle matches", () => {
  const bundle = match(["X"]);
  assert.ok(bundle);
});

test("returns null when no bundle is cheaper", () => {
  assert.strictEqual(match(["X", "IG"]), null);
});

test("throws when the key is missing", (t) => {
  const config = load({});
  t.assert.ok(config);
});

test("throws when the secret is missing", () => {
  assert.throws(() => load({ key: "k" }), /secret/);
});

test("returns 401 without a token", async () => {
  const response = await call({});
  assert.equal(response.body.error, "UNAUTHORIZED");
});

test("returns 401 with an expired token", async () => {
  const response = await call({ token: "old" });
  assert.equal(response.status, 401);
});

test("does not expose the secret", () => {
  assert.ok(config.secret);
});

test("never exposes the hash", () => {
  assert.equal(user.hash, undefined);
});
